meta.title: 这么拍花，包出片的～
meta.title_en: Shoot Flowers Like This — Great Photos, Guaranteed

scenes.context: 花是静态的，氛围感来自动态——用喷壶把风的形状具象化。
sentences: 我拍多了感觉都千篇一律的。
I've shot so many that they all look the same.
千篇一律=all look the same
花大多是静态的。
Flowers are mostly static.
static（静态的）
氛围感常来源于动态的时刻。
The atmosphere often comes from moments of motion.
motion（动态）
把风的形状具象化。
Make the shape of the wind visible.
make...visible（把…具象化）
paraphrase: 把「千篇一律」换个说法
All my flower shots end up looking identical.
「动态的时刻」另一种表达
The vibe usually comes from moving moments.
scenes.speak: I've shot so many that they all look the same. Flowers are mostly static. The atmosphere often comes from moments of motion. Make the shape of the wind visible.

scenes.context: 多雨的春季有朦胧的浪漫——把水喷到塑料板上，透过它拍花。
sentences: 多雨的春季有独属于它朦胧的浪漫。
The rainy spring has a hazy romance all its own.
hazy（朦胧的）
拿出了一块透明塑料板。
Take out a transparent plastic sheet.
transparent（透明的）
把水喷到塑料板上。
Spray water onto the plastic sheet.
spray（喷洒）
透过它去拍花。
Shoot the flowers through it.
shoot through（透过…拍摄）
paraphrase: 把「朦胧浪漫」换个说法
Spring rain brings a dreamy, misty charm.
「透过它拍」另一种表达
Use it as a filter between you and the flowers.
scenes.speak: The rainy spring has a hazy romance all its own. Take out a transparent plastic sheet. Spray water onto the plastic sheet. Shoot the flowers through it.

scenes.context: 背景杂乱时，用卡纸把画面平面化，像国画一样乱中取静。
sentences: 很多的时候花的背景很杂乱。
Quite often, the background is messy.
messy（杂乱的）
你想到了国画的处理方式。
You think of the Chinese ink-painting approach.
ink-painting（国画）
乱中取静。
Find calm within the chaos.
chaos（混乱）
模仿画作的装裱也可以。
You can even mimic a framed artwork.
mimic（模仿）
paraphrase: 把「背景杂乱」换个说法
The background behind the flowers is often cluttered.
「乱中取静」英文怎么地道表达
Seek stillness amid the clutter.
scenes.speak: Quite often, the background is messy. You think of the Chinese ink-painting approach. Find calm within the chaos. You can even mimic a framed artwork.

scenes.context: 花不一定长在地上树上——碎花瓣装进带水的碗，用 Live 图拍出生动。
sentences: 花一定要拍在地上树上的吗？
Do flowers have to be shot on the ground or on trees?
have to（非得…吗）
你捡起了一地的碎花瓣。
You pick up a handful of fallen petals.
fallen petals（落下的花瓣）
把它们装进了带水的碗中。
Drop them into a bowl of water.
drop into（放入）
充分利用 Live 图的特性。
Make full use of the Live Photo feature.
make full use of（充分利用）
paraphrase: 把「充分利用」换个说法
Take full advantage of the Live Photo mode.
「带水的碗」另一种说法
Put them in a bowl filled with water.
scenes.speak: Do flowers have to be shot on the ground or on trees? You pick up a handful of fallen petals. Drop them into a bowl of water. Make full use of the Live Photo feature.

scenes.title_en: A Scarf and a Slow Shutter
scenes.context: 轻盈有孔的纱巾，调慢快门拍出梦幻感；盖在镜头前，显出光的形状。
sentences: 它材质轻盈，还有细密的小孔。
It's light and full of tiny holes.
tiny holes（细密小孔）
调慢快门就得到了。
Slow down the shutter, and there you have it.
shutter（快门）
把它盖在镜头前。
Drape it in front of the lens.
drape（披挂）
显出光的形状。
Reveal the shape of the light.
reveal（显现）
不要错过每一个花期的到来。
Don't miss a single flower season.
flower season（花期）
paraphrase: 把「调慢快门」换个说法
Use a slower shutter speed, and the magic happens.
「光的形状」另一种表达
Show the light's form and texture.
scenes.speak: It's light and full of tiny holes. Slow down the shutter, and there you have it. Drape it in front of the lens. Reveal the shape of the light. Don't miss a single flower season.

practice: 我拍多了感觉都千篇一律的。
I've shot so many that they all look the same.
Spray water onto the plastic sheet.
充分利用 Live 图的特性。
Make full use of the Live Photo feature.
不要错过每一个花期的到来。
Don't miss a single flower season.
pitfalls: 主语复数时 be 动词用 are 而非 is
Make the shape of the wind visible.
make + 宾语 + 形容词补语的语序要放对
The background behind the flowers is mess.
The background behind the flowers is messy.
messy 是形容词，mess 是名词
Slow the shutter speed and take it.
Slow down the shutter, and there you have it.
slow down 才是调慢；there you have it 是成品示意
shifts: 用卡纸国画式乱中取静
碎花瓣、纱巾都能玩出新意
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：视频原文「沙巾」识别为「纱巾」、「梦何感」识别为「梦幻感」、「装表」识别为「装裱」，正文统一。
